title: Ship option 1, the grown-up painted face, after a two-day rig test
html:
She is the most clearly grown-up face here, and the only one with no doubts on age (judges: 25 to 40, centred near 33). She is never childish and never glamorous, she reads Indian in every run, and she stays the same person in all six frames. She also answers your words most directly: a grown-up face, a real teacher. And with an exactly-human voice, the most human face is the one least likely to feel wrong.

Her risk is how she moves, not how she looks. So before the full rebuild, a two-day test should rig only her eyes, six mouths and a small head turn, and show it in the 90 px lesson slot. If the paint smears or she reads like a moving photograph, switch to option 4 (lamplight flat). It suits today's rig best, because its flat shapes cut and fill cleanly. If you prefer a stylised face, option 2 (mature anime) is the stronger of the two stylised ones. Option 3 is the cheapest, but it looks the most basic.

Whichever you pick, grade her skin half-way toward Monk 6 when the rig is built.
